tips.name: Shoes By The Door
tips.action: Before bed, line up tomorrow's shoes by the door
tips.reason: Hunting for shoes is a classic late-morning scramble; setting them out avoids it.
tips.note: daily, under two minutes, due when leaving the house

tips.name: Hourly Desk Stretch
tips.action: Stand and stretch at the top of every hour
tips.reason: Breaking up long sitting eases a stiff back and neck.

possible_duplicate_of_tip.name: Stretch While The Kettle Boils
possible_duplicate_of_tip.action: Stretch your arms and back as the kettle heats

tips.note: near match: the same goal as the kettle stretch, at a different cue

tips.name: Hang Up Your Keys
tips.action: Put your keys on the hook the moment you get in
tips.reason: One home for the keys saves the search when you head out again.

duplicate_of_tip.name: Keys On The Hook
duplicate_of_tip.action: Hang your keys on the hook as you walk in

tips.note: duplicate: the same action at the same cue as Keys On The Hook

tips.name: Phone Sleeps Outside
tips.action: Charge your phone outside the bedroom at night
tips.reason: With the phone out of reach it is easier to put it down and fall asleep.
tips.note: daily, due at the bedtime routine

tips.name: Sunday Dinner Plan
tips.action: Plan the week's dinners on Sunday afternoon
tips.reason: Deciding meals once a week saves a nightly decision and extra shop trips.

tips.name: Tidy The Desk Cables
tips.action: Bundle the cables under your desk once
tips.reason: A tidy desk is nice to have, but it is a one-time setup, not a habit.

tips.name: Read The Router Manual
tips.action: Read your internet router's manual cover to cover
tips.reason: Rarely useful; the quick-start card covers what most homes need.
tips.note: left out: not worth the time

tips.name: Water Bottle In The Bag
tips.action: Pack a filled water bottle in the school bag
tips.reason: A bottle packed the night before means no thirsty afternoons at school.
tips.note: daily, due when leaving for school

tips.name: Library Trip Together
tips.action: Visit the library together once a month
tips.reason: A regular library visit keeps new books coming without buying them.
